title: Managed Database: native retention allocation — completed retention exports
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following completed retention exports basis. Sum quantity on completed supplemental backup storage service records for that source; pending, rejected and cancelled exports do not contribute.

## Selected-export case
Hypothetical native retention allocation records: two completed exports satisfying the stated source correlation contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the applicable usage unit. A pending export contains 40. The selected completed export total is 20; the pending quantity does not enter that total.
